mainEntity.name: Can I paint over existing stucco instead of restuccoing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Painting over stucco is an option for purely cosmetic improvements or to change the color of your home, but it does not address underlying structural or moisture issues. If your stucco has significant cracks, crumbling, or water damage, painting will only provide a temporary aesthetic fix and can trap moisture, potentially worsening problems. Restuccoing repairs and protects the wall system, offering a long-term solution for damaged or aged stucco surfaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Painting stucco offers cosmetic improvement but doesn't fix structural issues. If there's significant damage, restuccoing is a long-term solution that repairs and protects.
